page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes are absent apart from small marks in the margins. Running head at top; page number at top left; catchword "Carceri-" at the foot right.

main_text.p:
Obliquos aueriit equos, humilisque per oras
Circum extremas declivis moenia mundi,
Porrigit & longam exiguis de collibus umbram.
Ergo pigra jacet sine fruge, sine arbore tellus
Aut nimibus cums horrens, aut frigore torpens,
Obruta vel tetra caligine, rara ferarum,
Nulla per incultas hominum vestigia terras
Occurrunt, gelidis Boreas effusus ab antris
Saevit, & horriferis flabris sua regna flagellat,
Irati que maris lento torpore ligatas
Sternit aquas, stringitque gelu Neptunia regna,
Marmoreum fundens per languida stagna rigorem.
Par habitus caeli atque soli sub cardine mundi
Adverso, & simulus concreti ignavia ponit.

Proxima post gelidas duplex plaga tenditur oras:
Sed quas cultura patientes mitior aer
Efficit, hinc flammis glaciem soluentibus, illinc
Frigoribus rapidum flamma moderantibus aestum.
Altera finitima est arvis, qua Parrhasis & Arctos
Desficit, ad calidam a Thule porrecta Syenen:
Felix terra virum ingenii, & robore, felix
Frugibus, & foetu pecorum, qua postulat usus
Natura, quae luxuries profundere gaudet,
Quicquid doliis peperit corruptior aetas,
Sufficit e gremio tellus foecunda benigno.

At plaga ad algentem traus Aegocerota Canopon
Par caelo, non aqua solo, prope tota refusa
Mergitur oceano, late regna humida Nerei
Exercent canos vasto cum murmure fluctus.
Si qua patet magno tellus exorta profundo,
Barbaries inculta tenet, non legibus urbes
Diuinibus tenues aquant, non poena coercet

page.notes: Marginal marks (small symbols at the right and left edges) are printer's or reader's marks, not transcribed. Several words are uncertain in the printed Latin (e.g. "aueriit", "simulus", "traus", "Diuinibus"); the text reads as printed at this scan resolution. Possible faint show-through from the reverse side.
